item.title: The Future of Forecasting: Bridging Theory and Practice - A special Issue in Celebration of Rob J. Hyndman's 60th Birthday
item.content:encoded:
This special issue celebrates Rob J. Hyndman's 60th birthday and aims to bring together research that connects forecasting theory with practical applications. The issue welcomes contributions that address current and emerging challenges in forecasting methodology, demonstrating how theoretical advances can be applied to real-world problems.

Appel publié par International Journal of Forecasting. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
